# MyCreativeFX

> > MyCreativeFX provides royalty-free cinematic assets including 4K VFX overlays, sound effects, music jingles, and color grading LUTs for video editors and content creators.

The library features production-ready assets compatible with major editing platforms like Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, and CapCut. Resources include muzzle flashes, glitch effects, smoke overlays, transition SFX, logo jingles, and cinematic audio elements for filmmakers, YouTubers, and game developers.

## Key Topics

- 4K VFX overlays
- Royalty-free music and SFX
- Cinematic sound effects
- Muzzle flash and gunfire VFX
- Adobe Premiere Pro compatibility
- DaVinci Resolve workflows
- After Effects integration
- CapCut video editing
- Transition sound effects
- Logo jingles and branding audio
- Color grading LUTs
- Action and cinematic effects
- Glitch and VHS effects
- Final Cut Pro assets
- MP4 video overlays
